title: Glimpsed classified UAP photos via colleagues
summary: Bob McGwier tells of Glimpsed classified UAP photos via colleagues, about undated at US government classified settings, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: so I began to see all sorts of stuff I told you about earlier photos and other things that said UAP are here

plain: Bob McGwier, described as a former contractor for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, says that through colleagues in secret government settings he got to see classified material. He says this included photos and other records indicating that UAP, the government's term for unidentified objects in the sky, are really here. If true, it would mean the government holds hidden proof of such objects.
